mapper.sql: select i.indicator_id, i.indicator_name, i.create_time, i.project_total, i.annotation_category_total, i.species_id, i.organ_id, i.create_by, i.update_by, i.update_time, i.number, i.organization_id, u.user_id, u.user_name from tb_pathological_indicator i left join sys_user u on i.create_by = u.user_id
mapper.insert: insert into tb_pathological_indicator( indicator_name, species_id, organ_id, create_by, organization_id, number, create_time, project_total, annotation_category_total )values ( #{indicatorName}, #{speciesId}, #{organId}, #{createBy}, #{number}, #{organizationId}, sysdate(), 0, 0 )
mapper.select:
AND i.indicator_name like concat('%', #{indicatorName}, '%')
AND i.species_id like concat('%', #{speciesId}, '%')
AND i.organ_id like concat('%', #{organId}, '%')
AND i.organization_id like concat('%', #{organizationId}, '%')
AND i.create_by like concat('%', #{createBy}, '%')
AND u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')
AND date_format(i.create_time,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{createTimeParams.beginTime},'%y%m%d')
AND date_format(i.create_time,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{createTimeParams.endTime},'%y%m%d')
and i.del_flag=0
order by i.create_time desc

select pa.indicator_id, pa.indicator_name, pa.create_time, pa.project_total, pa.annotation_category_total, pa.create_by, pa.update_time, pa.update_by, u.user_id, u.user_name from tb_pathological_indicator pa left join sys_user u on pa.create_by = u.user_id where pa.indicator_id = #{indicatorId}

select distinct(pi.indicator_id), pi.indicator_name from tb_pathological_indicator as pi left join tb_project as p on p.indicator_id = pi.indicator_id
where p.project_id in
#{project_id}
Group by pi.indicator_id order by pi.indicator_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into tb_pathological_indicator(indicator_name, create_time) value (#{projectName}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select * from tb_pathological_indicator where del_flag = 0 order by indicator_id desc
select * from tb_pathological_indicator where indicator_name = #{indicatorName} and del_flag = 0
